stemMd: A manufacturer claims a new filter lasts twice as long because it handled twice as much water in a trial. Which fact would most weaken the claim?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The new filter was tested with water containing far fewer particles than the old filter’s test water.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The trial used containers to hold water.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Both filters had a printed label.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The new filter was displayed in a brochure.

explanationMd: Cleaner water may impose less load on a filter, allowing more volume before clogging even without a superior design. Different test conditions therefore provide an alternative explanation. A valid comparison should control the water’s relevant characteristics.

distractorRationale.c: Labels do not explain performance differences.
distractorRationale.d: Advertising does not identify the trial confound.
distractorRationale.b: Containers are expected and do not by themselves undermine comparability.
distractorRationale.e: Its product range is not relevant to this test comparison.
